## Parental OpControl 0.17.14

- My OpControl Messages no longer flickers: the conversation is updated in place instead of being cleared and rebuilt every few seconds. New messages are added once, delivery status changes in place, and the text being typed, focus and scroll position are kept.
- Enter now sends in My OpControl Messages and Shift+Enter starts a new line. IME composition, dead keys and accents (á, ñ) never send by accident. Empty or whitespace-only messages are rejected and the 500-character limit still applies.
- The same incremental refresh and Enter/Shift+Enter rule apply to the lock screen messaging panel.
- Home, Schedule, Rules and Activity also stop redrawing when a refresh returns the same data.
- Luna's sleeping moon only wakes and takes clicks on the visible yellow sliver. Points over the browser Back button, the square around the moon and the floating Z's pass mouse moves and clicks through to the window underneath, at every sleep size and scaling. The 0.4 s hover delay is unchanged.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
